summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature: iter_patch now yields (patch, coords) pairs and set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes (monai/data/utils.py); GridPatchDataset is reworked around an injected patch generator and the new PatchIter class is added and exported (monai/data/grid_dataset.py, monai/data/__init__.py); PatchIter autodoc entry added to docs/source/data.rst; tests/test_grid_dataset.py created with test_shape and test_loading_array. No tests were run and nothing was committed. The pinned test values come from the spec and are unverified, and the GridPatchDataset docstring example output was worked out by hand.
